description: Committee will send feedback on advisory committee operations.
Feedback includes earlier project input and public interaction.
Committee seeks more lead time for agenda items.

chips.text: Committee members want flexible mandates for new initiatives.
Formalizing co-sponsorship could set a new process for committees.
Co-sponsorship could support local groups for DEI-related events.

description: Environmental Advisory Committee finalizes 2027 work plan for Council.

chips.text: Senior planner advised updating 'Plan for Growth' to 'Official Community Plan'.
Work plan focuses on environmental best practices and sustainable growth.

description: Committee considers funding for a climate workshop in Toronto.
Participant would learn from other cities' climate efforts.

chips.text: Estimated workshop cost is $800 to $1,000 for attendance.
Councillors discussed budget details, including airfare, per diem, and accommodation costs.
Manvi Ghai, the applicant, would attend the workshop.
Applicant promised to present workshop learnings to the committee.

description: Establishes a subcommittee to engage local groups on water conservation.

chips.text: Local organizations and community members will be engaged.
Focuses on water conservation and quality management.
